== Summary ==
Commentators at the streaming desk: [[Justin Desai]] (centre) and [[Justin Miyashiro]] (right, his name is on his Players Committee Streaming Team shirt).

* '''Event:''' [[2022 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-10-18
* '''Camera date:''' 2022-10-15 or 2022-10-16 (inferred from the camera's file numbering; not in the image data)
* '''Identification:''' [[Justin Desai]]: face and the same shirt as in the [[:File:2022 World Championship Top 8.jpg|Top 8 photo]]. [[Justin Miyashiro]]: his name is embroidered on his shirt, and he played in the event. The man at left is not named.

== Source ==
Posted in the #worlds-2022 channel of the Players Committee Slack (starwarsccg.slack.com) by imrahil327, 2022-10-18. Original file name: IMG_4270.jpg (4032×3024); Slack file id F0475QE3DGC.
* '''Photographer / posted by:''' imrahil327
